Q: How do I apply for paid time off (PTO)?
A: You can submit a PTO request through the HR portal under "Time Off" at least 3 business days in advance. Your manager will approve or decline it within 2 business days.

Q: When is the monthly payroll processed?
A: Payroll is processed on the last working day of each month and typically reflects in your bank account within 1-2 business days.

Q: How can I access my payslips?
A: Payslips are available in the HR portal under "Payroll > Payslips" and are uploaded by the 5th of each month.

Q: What is the process for internal job transfers?
A: Employees interested in transferring to another department should apply through the Internal Job Postings board and inform their current manager after being shortlisted.

Q: Who do I contact to update my bank account or personal details?
A: You can update your bank account and personal details yourself in the HR portal under "My Profile", or email hr-support@shopunow.com for assistance.

Q: How many sick leaves am I entitled to per year?
A: Full-time employees are entitled to 10 paid sick leaves per calendar year, which do not carry over to the next year.

Q: When are performance reviews conducted?
A: Performance reviews are conducted twice a year, in April and October, followed by a calibration meeting with your manager.

Q: How do I report a workplace grievance?
A: Grievances can be reported confidentially through the HR portal's "Grievance Redressal" form or by emailing hr-grievance@shopunow.com.

Q: What is the notice period for resignation?
A: The standard notice period is 60 days for confirmed employees and 30 days during the probation period.

Q: Can I carry forward unused PTO to the next year?
A: Up to 5 unused PTO days can be carried forward to the next calendar year; anything beyond that is forfeited.

Q: How do I enroll in the company's health insurance plan?
A: New employees are auto-enrolled in the group health insurance plan within 30 days of joining; dependents can be added via the HR portal.

Q: What is the maternity/paternity leave policy?
A: ShopUNow offers 26 weeks of paid maternity leave and 2 weeks of paid paternity leave, in line with statutory requirements.
